bio: I am an enthusiastic Computer Science & Engineering student at AIUB. I specialize in building robust software solutions, scalable web applications, and resolving complex technical challenges.
aboutMe:
Hello! I am Mahafuzur Rahman, a motivated and dedicated Computer Science & Engineering student currently in my 11th semester at the American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB). I have built a solid foundation in software engineering, object-oriented programming, and database systems through my academic coursework and personal projects.

I enjoy developing applications and strengthening my programming skills using Java, C++, C#, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL. I am passionate about problem-solving, continuously learning new technologies, and building practical solutions that address real-world challenges.

I am currently seeking a Software Engineer Internship where I can apply my technical knowledge, gain hands-on industry experience, collaborate with experienced professionals, and continue growing as a software developer.

projects.title: POS Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive point-of-sale desktop application built with C# and SQL Server to manage sales, products, and receipts.
projects.longDescription: The POS Management System is a corporate-grade desktop solution built using C# .NET and SQL Server database. It streamlines transactions for retail businesses, allowing cashiers to register sales, print receipts, and track customer details. It features administrative role controls, automated real-time stock deductions on checkout, low-stock warnings, and detailed charts displaying sales performance over time.

projects.title: BloodConnectBD
projects.description: An emergency blood finding and notification platform connecting active donors with recipients.
projects.longDescription: BloodConnectBD is an interactive web platform designed to solve emergency blood requirements. Recipients can post urgent blood requests, which automatically alerts registered donors in the corresponding location. Users can search for blood donors by group and area using a streamlined dashboard. It features secure donor registration, emergency notifications, and availability management.

projects.title: Smart Air Quality Control System
projects.description: An IoT system prototype that monitors environmental particulate matters and triggers air filtration automatically.
projects.longDescription: This Smart Air Quality Control System is a hardware-software co-designed IoT prototype aimed at modern environmental monitoring. It senses levels of CO2, dust particles, and temperature. The sensor readings are streamed via WebSockets to an intuitive dashboard. When pollutants cross safe thresholds, the system automatically activates a ventilation fan and an air filtration unit.
